description: Hi! I am Sadia Sultana Iqra, lead of Team AstroHelix. I specialize in space biology , neuroscience , AI/ML, data analysis , UI/UX and science storytelling. I am building AstroHelix, an AI powered bio-resilience framework using NASA datasets to protect astronauts from neural and DNA damage . Joining AstroHelix means shaping the future of space biology , turning bio-data into life saving technology for future mission.
summary:
AstroHelix is an advanced AI-driven bio-resilience framework and interactive dashboard designed to predict and mitigate space-radiation-induced neural risks for deep-space crewed missions. Addressing the critical challenge of long-duration spaceflight cognitive health, AstroHelix integrates nine validated NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) datasets—including OSD-611, OSD-993, and OSD-479—alongside SpaceX Inspiration4 metagenomic data.
​At its core, the platform features the NeuroEcho prediction engine and the Neural Vulnerability Index (NVI), translating complex gene expression and radiation dose groups into actionable risk metrics. By benchmarking human cellular responses against extremophile resilience markers (such as the Tardigrade Dsup protein), AstroHelix provides mission planners with real-time risk assessment, pathway perturbation analysis, and countermeasure simulation. It bridges open space-biology data with practical decision support to ensure safer human journeys beyond Earth.
details: AstroHelix is an advanced AI-driven bio-resilience framework and interactive dashboard designed to safeguard astronaut brain health in deep space by integrating selected NASA open science datasets like OSD-611 and OSD-993. Utilizing the NeuroEcho prediction engine and the Neural Vulnerability Index (NVI), the platform translates complex gene expression and radiation dose responses into actionable risk metrics, empowering mission planners to decode neural stress, evaluate biological pathways, and test effective countermeasures for safer crewed missions beyond Earth.
